description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalHelpers module, testing parsing logic, pattern matching, validation, and decision requirements related to execution approval workflows.

methods.name: parseDecision
methods.description: Parses a decision string into a corresponding enum value, trimming whitespace and rejecting invalid inputs.

methods.name: allowlistPattern
methods.description: Determines the allowlist pattern to use based on command resolution; prefers resolved path when available.

methods.name: validateAllowlistPattern
methods.description: Validates a string pattern for allowlisting, returning reasons if invalid.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Checks if a given pattern string is a valid file system path pattern.

methods.name: requiresAsk
methods.description: Determines if user prompt is required based on security policy, allowlist match, and other parameters.
